section.content: 本实用新型属于生物基因研磨设备技术领域，具体为一种生物基因提取研磨装置，包括装置主体、底座和研磨器，装置主体的底部固定连接有底座，底座的顶部一侧固定连接有基座，基座的顶部固定连接有研磨器，研磨器的内部中间活动连接有转轴，转轴的底部嵌入连接有卡槽，卡槽的底部活动连接有卡块，卡块的底部活动连接有电机，电机在带动转轴进行转动后，能够让研磨珠在对生物基因提取材料进行研磨时，让挡块与刮板将黏在研磨珠的残留物刮干净，然后进行研磨，而拆卸机构能够在使用者使用装置主体进行生物基因提取完成后，将导管进行拆卸，然后将导管进行更换或者清洗，使得装置主体不会影响下一次生物基因提取的结果，在未来具有广泛的发展前景。

The utility model belongs to the technical field of biological gene grinding equipment, in particular to a biological gene extracting and grinding device, which comprises a device body, a base and a grinder, wherein the bottom of the device body is fixedly connected with the base, one side of the top of the base is fixedly connected with the base, the top of the base is fixedly connected with the grinder, the middle inside of the grinder is movably connected with a rotating shaft, the bottom of the rotating shaft is embedded and connected with a clamping groove, the bottom of the clamping groove is movably connected with a clamping block, the bottom of the clamping block is movably connected with a motor, after the motor drives the rotating shaft to rotate, when grinding materials for biological gene extracting are ground, the grinding beads are scraped clean by a stop block and a scraper blade, then grinding is carried out, and a dismounting mechanism can dismount a conduit after a user uses the device body to carry out biological gene extraction, and then replace or clean the conduit, the device main body can not influence the result of next biological gene extraction, and has wide development prospect in the future.

Biological gene draws grinderTechnical Field

The utility model relates to the technical field of biological gene grinding equipment, in particular to a biological gene extracting and grinding device.

Background

A gene (genetic element) is the entire nucleotide sequence required to produce a polypeptide chain or functional RNA. Genes support the basic architecture and performance of life. All information of the processes of race, blood type, inoculation, growth, apoptosis and the like of life is stored. The mutual dependence of environment and heredity deduces important physiological processes of life such as reproduction, cell division, protein synthesis and the like. All life phenomena of living body such as growth, aging, disease, aging and death are related to genes. It is also an intrinsic factor in determining life health. Thus, genes have dual attributes: materiality (presence) and informativeness (root attributes).

The present biological gene draws grinder can't scrape the residue of gluing in the grinder totally for the grinder is when grinding, and the grinder is not ideal enough to biological gene's grinding effect, leads to the result of drawing to have the deviation, and once grinds the back, can't dismantle the device of drawing and the device of grinding, makes the extraction element can exert an influence to the biological gene of drawing when drawing next time.

Therefore, how to design a biological gene extracting and grinding device becomes a problem that we need to solve at present.

SUMMERY OF THE UTILITY MODEL

An object of the utility model is to provide a biological gene draws grinder to propose in solving above-mentioned background art can't scrape the problem totally and can't dismantle the device that draws and the device that grinds glutinous the residue in the grinder.

In order to achieve the above object, the utility model provides a following technical scheme: a biological gene extracting and grinding device comprises a device body, a base and a grinder, wherein the base is fixedly connected to the bottom of the device body, the base is fixedly connected to one side of the top of the base, the grinder is fixedly connected to the top of the base, a rotating shaft is movably connected to the middle inside of the grinder, a clamping groove is embedded and connected to the bottom of the rotating shaft, a clamping block is movably connected to the bottom of the clamping groove, a motor is movably connected to the bottom of the clamping block, connecting rods are fixedly connected to two sides of the rotating shaft, a stop block is fixedly connected to the periphery of one side of each connecting rod, grinding beads are movably connected to one side of the stop block, scraping plates are fixedly connected to two ends of the rotating shaft, a leakage net is embedded and connected to the other side of the bottom inside of the grinder, the inner wall embedding of movable cover is connected with the screw thread, the inside swing joint of screw thread has the pipe, the bottom opposite side fixedly connected with of pipe draws the bottle, fixedly connected with locating piece in the middle of the top of mill.

Preferably, the periphery of the bottom of the base is fixedly connected with supporting legs.

Preferably, two sides of the top of the rotating shaft are movably connected with positioning beads.

Preferably, the two sides of the top of the grinder are connected with feed inlets in an embedded manner.

Preferably, the grinding mechanism is composed of a rotating shaft in the middle of the interior of the grinder, a motor at the bottom of the clamping block, connecting rods on two sides of the rotating shaft, a stop block on the periphery of one side of the connecting rods, grinding beads on one side of the stop block and scraping plates at two ends of the rotating shaft.

Preferably, the lug at the bottom of the strainer, the movable cover at the periphery of the lug, the thread on the inner wall of the movable cover and the conduit inside the thread form a dismounting mechanism together.

Compared with the prior art, the beneficial effects of the utility model are that:

1. this kind of biological gene draws grinder is provided with grinding mechanism in through the device main part, can will glue the residue of rubbing pearl and mill inner wall through dog and scraper blade in the mill with the biological gene that needs draw at the user and scrape totally, then grind for the grinding effect of mill is better, has improved the effect when the device main part grinds biological gene effectively.

2. This kind of biological gene draws grinder is provided with disassembly body in through the device main part, can use the device main part to carry out biological gene and draw the completion back at the user, dismantles the pipe, then changes or washs the pipe for the device main part can not receive the influence at the result when next biological gene draws, has improved the detachability of device main part effectively.

Drawings

FIG. 1 is a schematic diagram of the structure of the main body of the device of the present invention;

fig. 2 is a schematic sectional view of the device main body of the present invention;

fig. 3 is a schematic cross-sectional view of the device a of the present invention;

fig. 4 is a schematic sketch of the top view section of the grinder of the present invention.

In the figure: 1. the device comprises a device main body, 2, a base, 3, supporting legs, 4, a base, 5, a grinder, 6, a positioning block, 7, a feeding hole, 8, an extraction bottle, 9, a conduit, 10, a rotating shaft, 11, a motor, 12, a connecting rod, 13, a clamping block, 14, a positioning bead, 15, a movable cover, 16, a bump, 17, threads, 18, a leakage net, 19, a scraping plate, 20, a grinding bead, 21, a stop block, 22 and a clamping groove.

Detailed Description

The technical solution in the embodiments of the present invention will be clearly and completely described below with reference to the drawings in the embodiments of the present invention, and it is obvious that the described embodiments are only some embodiments of the present invention, rather than all embodiments, and all other embodiments obtained by a person of ordinary skill in the art without creative work belong to the protection scope of the present invention based on the embodiments of the present invention.

In a first embodiment, please refer to fig. 1-4, the present invention provides a technical solution: a biological gene extracting and grinding device comprises a device body 1, a base 2 and a grinder 5, wherein the base 2 is fixedly connected to the bottom of the device body 1, a base 4 is fixedly connected to one side of the top of the base 2, the grinder 5 is fixedly connected to the top of the base 4, a rotating shaft 10 is movably connected to the middle of the interior of the grinder 5, a clamping groove 22 is connected to the bottom of the rotating shaft 10 in an embedded manner, a clamping block 13 is movably connected to the bottom of the clamping groove 22, a motor 11 is movably connected to the bottom of the clamping block 13, connecting rods 12 are fixedly connected to the two sides of the rotating shaft 10, a stop 21 is fixedly connected to the periphery of one side of each connecting rod 12, grinding beads 20 are movably connected to one side of each stop 21, scraping plates 19 are fixedly connected to the two ends of the rotating shaft 10, a leakage net 18 is connected to, the inner wall embedding of movable cover 15 is connected with screw thread 17, and the inside swing joint of screw thread 17 has pipe 9, and the bottom opposite side fixedly connected with of pipe 9 draws bottle 8, and fixedly connected with locating piece 6 in the middle of the top of mill 5.

Preferably, the bottom of base 2 is fixedly connected with supporting legs 3 all around, and supporting legs 3 set up in base 2 bottom to be provided with four, support base 2 from base 2 all around, make the structure at base 2 top can remain stable when the operation, thereby can let mill 5 draw work to the bio-gene smoothly, prevent that mill 5 from shaking when grinding, and then influence the result of drawing of bio-gene, improved the support nature of device main part 1 effectively.

Preferably, both sides swing joint in the top of pivot 10 has location pearl 14, when pivot 10 is driven by motor 11 and is rotated, the top of pivot 10 can produce the friction with other contact surfaces, and if the top of pivot 10 is peripheral if there is not the object to fix a position it, the phenomenon of slope can appear in pivot 10, and then influences the grinding effect, and through the location pearl 14 of pivot 10 top both sides, can move about with location pearl 14 self, and fix in 6 inside both sides of locating piece, can restrict pivot 10 at the centre position, in order to prevent pivot 10 slope, and reduce the frictional force at pivot 10 top, the flexibility of device main part 1 has been improved effectively.

Preferably, the top both sides embedding of mill 5 is connected with feed inlet 7, when the user need use device main part 1 to draw the bio-gene, can put into mill 5 through the feed inlet 7 of mill 5 top both sides with corresponding material to feed inlet 7 is provided with two, can classify the material and place to avoid two kinds of materials to produce the reaction before putting into, makes bio-gene's the work of drawing normally go on, has improved device main part 1's practicality effectively.

Preferably, the rotating shaft 10 in the middle of the interior of the grinder 5, the motor 11 at the bottom of the clamping block 13, the connecting rods 12 at both sides of the rotating shaft 10, the stop 21 at the periphery of one side of the connecting rod 12, the grinding beads 20 at one side of the stop 21, and the scrapers 19 at both ends of the rotating shaft 10 together form a grinding mechanism, after a material to be subjected to biological gene extraction is placed in the grinder 5, a user can manually open the motor 11 at the bottom of the clamping block 13 to rotate the motor, and because the motor 11 and the rotating shaft 10 in the middle of the interior of the grinder 5 can be mutually fixed, the rotating shaft 10 can be rotated under the driving of the motor 11, then the connecting rods 12 at both sides of the rotating shaft 10 are driven to rotate in the interior of the grinder 5 and stir the gene extraction material, and because the grinding beads 20 at one side of the stop 21 are tightly attached to the inner wall of the, the grinding bead 20 moves on the inner wall of the grinder 5 and presses the inner wall of the grinder 5 mutually, the material stirred by the connecting rod 12 to the vicinity of the grinding bead 20 is ground, if the residue adhered on the grinding bead 20 exists, the residue adhered on the grinding bead 20 can be scraped by the stopper 21 on the periphery of one side of the connecting rod 12 while the grinding bead 20 rotates, so as to be scraped from the grinding bead 20, and the residue adhered on the inner wall of the grinder 5 can be scraped from the inner wall of the grinder 5 by the scrapers 19 on the two ends of the rotating shaft 10, so that the grinding effect of the biological gene to be extracted by the grinder 5 is better, therefore, the biological gene to be extracted can be scraped cleanly in the grinder 5 by a user through the stopper 21 and the scraper 19, then, the grinding is performed, so that the grinding effect of the grinder 5 is better, and the effect of the device body 1 on grinding the biological gene is effectively improved.

Preferably, the lug 16 at the bottom of the strainer 18, the movable cover 15 at the periphery of the lug 16, the thread 17 on the inner wall of the movable cover 15 and the conduit 9 inside the thread 17 form a dismounting mechanism together. After the user extracts the biological gene by the device main body 1, the user can manually rotate the movable cover 15 at the periphery of the convex block 16, the thread 17 on the inner wall of the movable cover 15 is separated from the thread 17 on the conduit 9 inside the thread 17, so that the conduit 9 can be detached from the convex block 16 at the bottom of the leakage net 18, then the conduit 9 is replaced or cleaned, so as not to influence the next biological gene extraction result, after the conduit 9 is required to be installed, the movable cover 15 can be manually reversed, because the top of the movable cover 15 is clamped on the convex block 16, after the movable cover 15 is reversed, the top of the conduit 9 can be superposed with the bottom of the convex block 16, so that the two can be connected, the extracted biological gene flows into the extraction bottle 8, and after the biological gene extraction by the device main body 1 is completed, the guide tube 9 is disassembled, and then the guide tube 9 is replaced or cleaned, so that the result of the device main body 1 when next biological gene extraction is carried out can not be influenced, and the detachability of the device main body 1 is effectively improved.

The working principle is as follows: first, supporting legs 3 are arranged at the bottom of base 2, four supporting legs are arranged, and base 2 is supported from the periphery of base 2, so that the structure at the top of base 2 can be kept stable during operation, grinder 5 can smoothly extract biogene, grinder 5 is prevented from shaking during grinding, the biological gene extraction result is further influenced, and the supporting performance of device main body 1 is effectively improved.

Then, when the rotating shaft 10 is driven by the motor 11 to rotate, the top of the rotating shaft 10 can generate friction with other contact surfaces, and if there is no object on the periphery of the top of the rotating shaft 10 to position the rotating shaft, the rotating shaft 10 can tilt, and further the grinding effect is affected, and the positioning beads 14 on the two sides of the top of the rotating shaft 10 can move, and are fixed on the two sides inside the positioning block 6, the rotating shaft 10 can be limited in the middle position, so that the tilting of the rotating shaft 10 is prevented, the friction force on the top of the rotating shaft 10 is reduced, and the flexibility of the device main body 1 is effectively improved.

Then, when the user needs to use the device main body 1 to extract the biological genes, corresponding materials can be put into the grinder 5 through the feed inlets 7 on the two sides of the top of the grinder 5, and the feed inlets 7 are provided with two materials which can be classified and placed so as to avoid the reaction of the two materials before the two materials are put into the grinder, so that the biological gene extraction work can be normally carried out, and the practicability of the device main body 1 is effectively improved.

Next, after the user puts the material to be bio-gene extracted into the grinder 5, the user can manually open the motor 11 at the bottom of the fixture block 13 to rotate the material, and because the motor 11 and the rotating shaft 10 in the middle of the grinder 5 can be fixed to each other, the rotating shaft 10 can be driven by the motor 11 to rotate, then the connecting rods 12 at both sides of the rotating shaft 10 are driven to rotate inside the grinder 5, and the gene-extracted material is stirred, and because the grinding beads 20 at one side of the stopper 21 are tightly attached to the inner wall of the grinder 5, while the rotating shaft 10 rotates, the grinding beads 20 move on the inner wall of the grinder 5, and mutually extrude the inner wall of the grinder 5 to grind the material stirred by the connecting rods 12 near the grinding beads 20, if there is residue adhered to the grinding beads 20, while the grinding beads 20 rotate by the stopper 21 at one side of the connecting rods 12, scrape the residue that will be stained on grinding pearl 20 to scrape it down from grinding pearl 20, and the residue that glues at the inner wall of grinder 5 can be scraped it down from the inner wall of grinder 5 through the scraper blade 19 of pivot 10 both ends, make grinder 5 can be better to the grinding effect of the biological gene that needs to draw, so through being provided with grinding mechanism in device main part 1, can be with the biological gene that needs to draw scraping clean the residue that glues at grinding pearl 20 and grinder 5 inner wall through dog 21 and scraper blade 19 in grinder 5 at the user, then grind, make the grinding effect of grinder 5 better, the effect when device main part 1 has improved the biological gene grinding effectively.

And finally. After the user extracts the biological gene by the device main body 1, the user can manually rotate the movable cover 15 at the periphery of the convex block 16, the thread 17 on the inner wall of the movable cover 15 is separated from the thread 17 on the conduit 9 inside the thread 17, so that the conduit 9 can be detached from the convex block 16 at the bottom of the leakage net 18, then the conduit 9 is replaced or cleaned, so as not to influence the next biological gene extraction result, after the conduit 9 is required to be installed, the movable cover 15 can be manually reversed, because the top of the movable cover 15 is clamped on the convex block 16, after the movable cover 15 is reversed, the top of the conduit 9 can be superposed with the bottom of the convex block 16, so that the two can be connected, the extracted biological gene flows into the extraction bottle 8, and after the biological gene extraction by the device main body 1 is completed, the guide tube 9 is disassembled, and then the guide tube 9 is replaced or cleaned, so that the result of the device main body 1 when next biological gene extraction is carried out can not be influenced, and the detachability of the device main body 1 is effectively improved.
